connectionPrerequisites: Install the package through the App Hub-owned Codex channel.
Start a fresh Codex session after installation or update.
Use Codex host-managed delegated App Hub OAuth when private capabilities are needed.

lifecycle.acquire: Acquire the approved package from the App Hub distribution entry point.
lifecycle.install: Install the package using the Codex host's custom channel or local package flow.
lifecycle.activate: Start a fresh Codex session so Skills and MCP configuration are loaded.
lifecycle.connect: Complete delegated App Hub OAuth through the Codex host; never add credentials to the package.
lifecycle.verify: Run a low-risk discovery or bundle guidance check and confirm the required capability is available.
lifecycle.update: Select a newer approved App Hub release, verify its integrity metadata, then reinstall and start a fresh session.
lifecycle.disconnect: Disconnect or revoke the delegated App Hub authorization through Codex and App Hub account controls.
lifecycle.remove: Remove the Codex package and separately clear any remaining host configuration or authorization.
